name: ONKOD
tagline: Android keyboard for the Somali language
description: ONKOD is an Android keyboard built for the Somali language, offering QWERTY and ASHERTY layouts built with Jetpack Compose. Latin-script Somali keyboards are rare, which makes ONKOD one of the least-represented language projects on GitHub. It is a focused, accessible tool for Somali speakers and a meaningful example of software serving an underserved language community.
highlights: Android keyboard purpose-built for the Somali language
QWERTY and ASHERTY layouts built with Jetpack Compose
One of the least-represented language projects on GitHub
curatorNote: Software for underserved languages is always worth a spotlight. ONKOD fills a real gap for Somali speakers with a clean, modern Android keyboard.
